events.verdict: Ingram (LAL) cleanly blocks Butler's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] James (LAL) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Butler (MIN) cleanly dislodges the ball from Ingram (LAL) during his play at the basket and he does not initiate any body contact.
James (LAL) loses control of the ball in the frontcourt and makes contact with the ball in the backcourt.
Ingram (LAL) momentarily places two hands on Gibson (MIN) but slides them off immediately.
Rose (MIN) moves his pivot foot after he gathers the ball.
Kuzma (LAL) birefly places two arms on Butler (MIN) but does not affect his ability to defend.
Kuzma (LAL) establishes legal position in Butler's (MIN) path and firms up on his left leg during the pick.
Towns (MIN) moves his pivot foot.
Towns (MIN) establishes legal position in Hart's (LAL) path and absorbs contact during the pick.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with Hart (LAL) during his post-up but does not affect his ability to defend.
Hart (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Towns' (MIN) shot attempt near the rim.
Kuzma (LAL) briefly grasps Gibson's (MIN) shorts during rebounding.
Towns (MIN) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) during the pick but does not affect his SQBR.
Teague (MIN) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
Gibson (MIN) cleanly blocks Kuzma's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Teague (MIN) establishes legal position in Ingram's (LAL) path and does not deliver the contact.
Video evidence is inconclusive if Rondo (LAL) makes contact with Butler's (MIN) arm on the jump shot attempt.
James (LAL) maintains his pivot foot.
Rose (MIN) avoids making contact with James (LAL) during his jump shot attempt.
Gibson (MIN) cleanly blocks Hart's (LAL) shot attempt.
James (LAL) sets the screen on Rose (MIN) and continues moving into him without allowing him to avoid the contact.
Rondo (LAL) commits a take foul on Towns (MIN).
